body.text: LIVE CROSS-FABRIC REVIEW for r2c-cli-native-estate-closure. Preserve named native Power identity and canonical ownership: shell/operator surface != implementation owner; Akai compatibility projection != canonical owner; Run8 != public Bonfyre runtime. The ! raw-shell path must produce a governed ProcessOccurrence through authority/effect/evidence boundaries, never bypass them. ?usage and ?economics must be deterministic derivations over canonical refs, not billing side effects or a parallel ledger. Prove at least one real named-Power round trip: semantic address -> Operator ABI -> native owner -> physical occurrence -> evidence. Also prove a live traversal equivalent to @work/r2c-model-usage-finance-closure |> ?realizations |> ?usage |> ?economics |> ?evidence, with WHY preserving exact input, physical occurrence, usage/economics, and evidence as distinct layers. Return sanitized changed-path/evidence refs through the mesh; do not satisfy this with docs-only aliases or generic verb wrappers.

subject: Semantic shell and native Power closure: ownership, raw-shell boundary, finance traversal
